subject: Pilot spend corridor and PO trigger pathway
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + budget corridor for the pilot

Hi Elena — great to meet today and thanks for the candid product roadmap details. Per our call, I wanted to capture the simplest path for a 6–8 week pilot that proves perf/cost for your summarization and triage flows. Two quick asks to align procurement and internal stakeholders this week: 

1) Budget corridor: can you confirm an expected monthly spend band for the pilot? From similar customers we see efficient pilots land in the $8k–$40k/month range depending on throughput and KV caching. If you have a narrower internal corridor (e.g., $8k–$15k or $15k–$40k) call that out now so I route the right procurement path.

2) Unit economics target: is there an internal target you want to hit for cost per 1M tokens (for budgeting)? E.g., $200–$500/1M tokens is common for production-focused pilots after batching and cache.

Next steps I propose: I’ll send a one-page pilot SOW + 3 pricing bands that map to monthly commit and PO thresholds (fast PO vs finance approval). If procurement needs a PO-only path (no contract redlines), we can show a PO-only lane for commitments under $10k/month and a contract lane for >$10k/month.

If you can reply with the monthly corridor and whether procurement wants PO vs contract for the pilot, I’ll lock in the SOW and send a pricing summary.

Thanks again — enjoyed the discussion.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
From: Elena Park <elena.park@orchardhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchard Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + budget corridor for the pilot

Rishi — thanks for the recap. Short answers below: 

- Monthly corridor: our initial pilot budget lives in the $10k–$25k/month band. We can stretch to $35k/month if we get clear SLAs and a short-term price cap.
- Unit economics: procurement would prefer a ballpark $300/1M tokens or below for us to sign off quickly; we understand that optimization (batching, quant) can improve this.
- PO vs contract: Procurement prefers PO-only for pilot commitments up to $25k/month. Anything over that will require our legal team to review an SOW and contract redlines. I’ve cc’d procurement so they can confirm.

Procurement — quick question for you: is PO-only under $25k/month workable from your side? If so, please confirm the PO template and payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Director, ML Systems
Orchard Health
From: Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orchardhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + budget corridor for the pilot

Elena / Rishi — finance here. We can do PO-only for vendor engagements under $25k/month. A couple of constraints: 

- PO threshold: under $25k/month is approved by Sourcing + Finance. Anything over that requires Legal + Procurement joint review and a signed SOW.
- Payment terms: default Net 45 for pilot vendors; we can accept Net 30 if Redwood provides a short commercial invoice cadence and a single-point-of-contact.
- Insurance/controls: we will need a SOC 2 attestation or evidence of encryption-in-transit for the pilot (simple attestation PDF is ok at pilot stage).

Please attach the pilot SOW draft and the pricing summary (bands) and we’ll route internally.

—Procurement Team
Orchard Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orchardhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + budget corridor for the pilot

Thanks for the quick responses — copying the plan so everyone has it in one thread. 

Summary & next steps (action items):

1) Budget corridor confirmed: $10k–$25k/month (PO-only lane). Procurement confirmed PO-only under $25k/month and Net 45 default.

2) Pricing bands: I’ve attached a short pricing summary that maps to three commit tiers and expected token volumes + an example unit $/1M tokens after batching and cache. (Attachment: redwood-pilot-pricing-summary.xlsx)

3) SOW & PO: I’ll attach a one-page SOW draft for a 6-week pilot and a contract redline for your legal team to reference if we exceed the PO threshold. (Attachments: orchard_sow_draft.docx, contract_redline.pdf)

4) Security evidence: we’ll provide a SOC 2 attestation PDF and a short security checklist for the pilot (I’ll drop that into the Drive link).

5) Timeline: if procurement can issue the PO by 07/12 we can start the pilot the week of 07/19. If you need the legal path, we’ll parallelize SOW review but expect a 2–3 week additional lead time.

Please confirm Net 45 is ok and I’ll update the SOW to reflect that payment term. Also, Elena — if you can share an initial estimated daily token volume (or example requests per day) I’ll map the expected spend to the tiers so Finance has a clear projection.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
